content_units: Bakery Sales Snapshot
This dataset is best suited to a small set of simple trend and mix visuals.
Across January to June 2025, total sales rise from   10,100   to   12,450  , with   Cakes   leading throughout and   Coffee   showing the steadiest growth.
Best Charts for This Monthly Sales Data
Chart Type   Best Use   Why it works here
Line chart   Monthly trend by category   Best for showing how Cakes, Cookies, and Coffee change over time side by side
Stacked column chart   Total monthly sales plus category contribution   Shows both total monthly performance and how each product contributes to that total
100% stacked column chart   Product mix by month   Useful for seeing whether category share is shifting even when totals grow
Clustered bar/column chart   Direct month-by-month category comparison   Makes it easy to compare Cakes vs Cookies vs Coffee in each month
Area chart   Overall growth pattern   Good if you want a more visual emphasis on rising total volume, but less precise than a line chart
Donut or pie chart   Total contribution across the full 6 months   Works only as a summary view for overall category share, not for trends
Recommended Visual Setup
1) Primary chart: Line chart
- Plot Month on the x-axis
- Plot sales value on the y-axis
- Use 3 lines: Cakes, Cookies, Coffee
- This should be your main chart because trend is the most important story here
2) Secondary chart: Stacked column chart
- One column per month
- Stack Cakes, Cookies, Coffee
- Best for quickly showing that overall bakery sales generally increase over the period
3) Optional third chart: 100% stacked column
- Focuses on category mix rather than raw totals
- Helpful if you want to know whether Coffee is becoming a bigger part of sales
Chart title:   Bakery Monthly Sales by Product Category (Jan-Jun 2025)
X-axis label:   Month
Y-axis label:   Sales
Sales Breakdown and Key Insights
Month   Cakes   Cookies   Coffee   Total
Insight 1: Overall sales trend is positive.
Total monthly sales increase from   10,100   in January to   12,450   in June, a gain of   2,350   or about   23.3%  . The bakery is growing overall, despite a few category dips.
Insight 2: Cakes are the top revenue driver, but they are more volatile.
Cakes lead every month and peak at   5,300   in May, then drop to   4,900   in June. That suggests Cakes are the strongest category, but demand may be more seasonal or promotion-sensitive.
Insight 3: Coffee shows the steadiest growth, while Cookies finish strong.

Coffee rises every single month from   2,800   to   3,550  , making it the most consistent growth line. Cookies also perform well, ending at   4,000   in June after a steady upward trend with only a small dip in May.
